Other stations 3

Enchantment RipperEnchantment Ripper

Not a recipe list: pulls chosen enchantments off an item (mask picked in the GUI).

code:RipperMenu.result
Lake WeedFound in the Everglade

New in 4.9.0. Not crafted: an underwater weed that fills almost all Everglade water. It grows upward like kelp, you can swim through it but it slows you down. Boatbreakers now also lurk in Everglade water 5+ blocks deep, often inside the weed.

code:LakeWeed490
Lonely Warlock's tradesLonely Warlock (Acorn Grove cottage)

Changed in 4.9.1: every trade uses Polished Emeralds (was Cut Emeralds). Changed in 4.9.2: the Totem of Undying also costs 2 Polished Rubies. Sells: 1 Colossal Oak Acorn for 20 Polished Emeralds; 3 random animal spawn eggs for 8-16 each; 3 random useful items (Name Tag 6, Saddle 8, 2 Leads 4, 4 Golden Carrots 5, 2 Ender Pearls 6, 3 Bottles o' Enchanting 5, 3 Glow Ink Sacs 3, Bundle 4, Spyglass 6, 2 Honey Bottles 3, 2 Slimeballs 4, 2 Blaze Powder 6, 4 Amethyst Shards 3, Totem of Undying 32 Polished Emeralds + 2 Polished Rubies, Clock 5, Compass 4, Brush 3, 4 Firework Rockets 3). Buys: 8 Brown Mushrooms or 4 Spider Eyes for 1 Polished Emerald. Stock refills every 3 in-game days.

code:LonelyWarlock
